passes_rule: Every feature starts with passes set to false. Only Lead may set passes to true. Build must not set any passes value to true.

features.title: Bay booking
features.on_main: A member can book bays 1 to 5. Two bookings cannot take the same hour once that proof is on main.

features.title: Shop hoist request
features.on_main: A member can request the shop hoist. It stays pending until an Owner or an approved bot confirms it.

features.title: Parts request
features.on_main: A member parts request is a row. It is not a checkout.

features.title: Tool crib
features.on_main: A checkout and a return are rows. A camera feed is not in.

features.title: Jobs
features.on_main: A claim and a done mark are rows.
